BiblicalUsage: A swamp is the word for marshy ground, and it appears three times, always where water and dry land meet. Job 8:11 asks, can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water? Job 40:21 says the behemoth lies under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed and fens. And Ezekiel 47:11 says the miry places of the healing river shall not be healed, but given to salt.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the swamp in Ezekiel is the sober note in a hopeful chapter: even the river of life leaves some miry places, and not everything is healed yet.
